text:
Renee H: quick alert from the Apr close recon. a batch of commit credits from the APR-EDGE partner run were applied but the system created deferral lines with the wrong amortization term (12m instead of 24m). noticed during schedule roll-forward.
Diego M: ouch. do we have invoice ids and sample rows?
Renee H: pasted CSV excerpt from revrec_export.csv:
```
invoice_id,customer,partner,invoice_date,amount,deferral_code,amort_months
INV-2026-1120,ursa-tech,Edge-APR,2026-04-05,12000,DEF-PARTNER,12
INV-2026-1134,ursa-tech,Edge-APR,2026-04-20,6000,DEF-PARTNER,12
INV-2026-1149,solace-ai,Edge-APR,2026-04-29,8000,DEF-PARTNER,12
```
Renee H: expected amort_months = 24 per partner contract. total mis-amortized = $26,000 (would accelerate recognition).
Sofia P: materiality?
Renee H: $26k recognized faster than intended for Apr (affects recognized revenue and deferred balances). above our $20k internal attention threshold for the month.
Diego M: root cause guess: partner-configs default term for Edge-APR was mistakenly set to 12 in the new onboarding script. did config change in April?
Oliver K: checked git history 1 Apr PR changed defaults: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-configs/pull/501. config shows term_months: 12 for partner "Edge-APR". looks like human error during onboarding.
Sofia P: okay next steps: 1) create reversing JE to move accelerated recognized revenue back to deferred liability (so revenue matched policy); 2) update revenue schedules to replace 12m lines with 24m amortization starting May 1 and create catch-up amortization schedule; 3) remediate partner-configs default and add a schema validation to prevent term < contract_min.
Diego M: recommended JE: DR 4000-REVENUE-PARTNER $26,000 / CR 2300-DEFERRED-PARTNER $26,000 with memo "reverse accelerated recognition due to partner config error (RR-2026-0839)". This will move the Apr recognized amounts back to deferred.
Renee H: cash/AR unaffected (invoices paid). this is classification/timing only. need approvals from accounting manager and revenue ops.
Sofia P: i approve. Diego, as accounting lead?
Diego M: approve. add contract excerpt showing 24m term to ticket and attach PR that introduced the bad default.
Oliver K: i've opened PR to fix default and add validation: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-configs/pull/504. also adding unit test ensuring term_months >= contractual_min.
revrec-bot: created ticket RR-2026-0839 assigned to @Renee H; due 2026-05-03; required attachments: revrec_export.csv, partner contract excerpt, config PRs.
Renee H: attaching contract clip and the export to the ticket. one question: should we treat this as prior-period adjustment for external reporting? this occurred within the same quarter (Q2) and not yet reported.
Sofia P: treat within Q2 close pack; document as correction in May close with a schedule footnote. not a restatement.
Diego M: also loop tax if partner rebate impacts VAT withholding. tagging tax in ticket.
Renee H: will do. final note for close memo: "Reversal JE to correct accelerated recognition caused by partner config onboarding error; amortization term corrected from 12 to 24 months (RR-2026-0839)."
Oliver K: monitoring: running a diff across partner-configs to ensure no other partners have erroneous terms.
Renee H: thanks all 609. posting JE in May close once ticket approved. will update when complete.
Sofia P: approved for posting. closing loop unless auditors request more detail. :white_check_mark:
